label: Wu 2024
setting: four US sites (University of Minnesota, Ohio State University, Johns Hopkins University, University of Alabama at Birmingham); clinic or phone
diagnosis_mix: top three diagnoses overall (Table): macular degeneration n = 74; glaucoma n = 65; cataract n = 25; other diagnoses not broken down
recruitment: participants from previous studies or patients at each site contacted by researchers; recruited Jun 2019-Feb 2022; no VA/field/diagnosis requirement so as to span a wide VA range (-0.3 to 2 logMAR)
notes: pct_glaucoma = 65/385 = 16.9 (derived from Table 'All' row); pct_female 57 as printed in Table. Administration by interviewer over phone or in clinic; survey took 30 to 60 minutes (Methods, VA Survey) - range only so time_to_administer_min = NR. VA mostly Bailey-Lovie or ETDRS charts, some Snellen (possibly 20-30%, Discussion), converted to logMAR; some VA from health records; eye and correction for VA NR. Inclusion: age 18+, VA available, English. Abstract says mean age 56.7 vs Table 55.71 (Table used). Paper does not state cohort overlap with other studies.
